reader.requirement: At --std 85 every argument-1 of FUNCTION MIDRANGE must be class numeric, i.e. an arithmetic expression (§1989:A.2.2 AR1): numeric items, literals, expressions, numeric/integer function-identifiers and table(ALL) are accepted, and alphabetic, alphanumeric (edited, group, ref-modified), nonnumeric-literal and alphanumeric-function arguments are refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ArgPredicate.AppliesAt(edition year); the MIDRANGE row carries no predicate, so nothing switches
IndexDataItemAdmittedAt(DialectLevel): USAGE INDEX argument refused COBOL6979 at 85, COBOL1627 at 2023

reader.edition-search: same greps as MEDIAN: the MIDRANGE Verified row (Uniform 'n') and Admissible/Violation are edition-blind.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: identical class screen at 85 and 2023; only the index-data-item diagnostic code differs
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f37_04 covers accepted numeric arguments; the refusal half, expressions, function-identifiers, table(ALL)/ODO and extreme values are not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL1627 at X item, "123", ZZ9 item, A item, group, (N1 X1) argument-2, FUNCTION CHAR(66), N1(1:1), SPACE; COBOL1637 index-name; COBOL6979 USAGE INDEX item

reader.notes: Same mechanism as MEDIAN (Verified Uniform 'n' through CheckArgumentClasses). Every refusal class fired and every accept probe printed the RV1 value. The diagnostic cites §2023 clause numbers and names 'national' for SPACE at 85, a wording nit only.

refuter.evidence: Same attack as MEDIAN. zero_mid.cob at --std 85: MIDRANGE(ZERO 4 6) printed 3.0000 and MIDRANGE(ZEROS - 3, 8) printed 2.5000, accepted and correct per §1989:A.2.26.4 RV1. tab2.cob: MIDRANGE(C(2 ALL) C(ALL 1)) mixing two ALL forms printed -2.0000 ((-8+4)/2). bad_tbl.cob: MIDRANGE(XE(ALL)) with an alphanumeric table element refused COBOL1627. later_lit.cob: MIDRANGE(1.0E1 2) refused COBOL0900. No edition site the reader missed. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.26.3 AR1 (the text is in AR1); OK §1989:A.2.2 AR1; OK §1985:VI.6.2.1.
